summary: Surveyed the full checkout (reservoir-sources/Verified-zkEVM__evm-asm): all 3120 .lean files across EvmAsm/, scripts/lean/, and root Main*.lean entry points; only non-.lean files are project docs (AGENTS.md, README.md, etc.), lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, lean-toolchain, LICENSE, Dockerfile -- none of which are in any review unit's file list (100% .lean across all 10 units' combined file lists). Ran a whole-word grep for theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom across the tree, finding 83 files with no such keyword. Read every one of the 83 completely and classified them: 42 are `-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-rv64-shims.py` shims re-exporting names now living in the riscv-zkvm dependency (a redirect/alias pattern directly analogous to mathlib4's deprecated_module stubs); 12 are `register_simp_attr`/attribute-declaration files split out because Lean 4 forbids using an attribute in the file that declares it; 57 (with overlap) are documented 'compatibility hub'/'public import'/'umbrella' re-export files that exist to keep a downstream registry module under a file-size review cap, per their own header comments; one (EvmAsm/Codegen/RoundTripTests.lean) is not import-only at all -- it holds 80+ `#guard` executable elaboration-time assertions checking the RISC-V instruction encoder, an executable formal command under FILTER-007's carve-out. All of these keep import edges, module identity, and/or executable content, so none meet FILTER-004's bar for hard exclusion. One file, EvmAsm/EL/Conformance/All.lean (23 bytes), is a bare `module`/`public section` declaration with no imports and no declarations of its own, imported once from EvmAsm/EL.lean; it matches no existing hard-exclusion precedent (FD-001 is zero-byte files only; the whitespace-only decision requires the file to be entirely whitespace, and this one contains the `module`/`public section` keywords) and its value is genuinely uncertain, so per FILTER-002's default it is retained rather than excluded on a novel unprecedented basis. No file in this source is a generated data table, LLM transcript, vendored copy, or test fixture outside the formal-source tree.
